description: This file defines the interface for an Options class used for command-line argument parsing within the WPEFramework Core namespace. It declares constructors, destructor, member functions, and private data members related to command-line options handling.

classes.name: Options
classes.description: An abstract class providing an interface for command-line options parsing, including methods for checking errors, retrieving commands, requesting usage information, and parsing options.

methods.name: Options()
methods.description: Deleted default constructor, preventing instantiation without parameters.

methods.name: Options(const Options&)
methods.description: Deleted copy constructor, preventing copying of Options instances.

methods.name: operator=
methods.description: Deleted assignment operator, preventing assignment of Options instances.

methods.name: Options(int argumentCount, TCHAR* arguments[], const TCHAR options[])
methods.description: Constructor initializing the Options object with command-line arguments and options string.

methods.name: HasErrors()
methods.description: Returns true if the options parsing encountered errors (i.e., if not valid).

methods.name: Command()
methods.description: Returns the command string parsed from arguments.

methods.name: RequestUsage()
methods.description: Indicates whether the user has requested usage information or if the options are invalid.

methods.name: Option(const TCHAR option, const TCHAR* argument)
methods.description: Pure virtual method to handle individual option parsing, to be implemented by derived classes.

methods.name: Parse()
methods.description: Method to parse command-line arguments based on the options string.

methods.name: RequestUsage(bool value)
methods.description: Sets the flag indicating whether usage information is requested.
